answer: Proposal: bind each scoring identity to a chip-unique TEE attestation key, remote-attested with fresh nonces each epoch, so an attacker must present live hardware. An enclave key is not a pigment: a thousand clones on one device attest as one identity. Gaining N weights means buying N devices — cost linear in N, a dune grown grain by grain — deterring only while per-device amortized cost over the full horizon exceeds capped marginal reward. Trust stands on one ridge: manufacturers' endorsement keys. Weak to cloud TEE rental and forged attestation.
